---
name: Adapter request
about: Verdikt cannot read my eval harness's output
title: "adapter: <harness name>"
labels: adapter
---

**Which harness?**
Name, version, and a link if it is public.

**Attach a real output file**
A single eval output file, with any sensitive fields removed. This is the important part —
an adapter cannot be written or tested against output nobody has seen.

**What does one row mean?**
Which field is the success label, which is the episode index, and is there a per-episode seed?

**How is success defined?**
Human-graded, simulator-graded, or scripted? Verdikt prints this on every line that uses it.
